scope: Default-OFF, Train-only qualification evidence caller; not qualification authority

entry_points.sync_body: body(**context) invokes asyncio.run(collect(**context)); use only outside a running event loop, within the Mayor-owned services.run callback
entry_points.default: Without --execute, unchanged services.run OFF gate returns 2 before effects
entry_points.success: collect returns None; report contains strict-JSON engineering_episode and qualification_caller evidence, not a Native PASS
entry_points.failure: Original BaseException is reraised with its original traceback; secondary errors remain in caller_errors/notes and qualification_caller_report

caller_prerequisites: Existing live Mayor-owned NominalServices scope; this module does not acquire a lease or grant authority.
Original owner.deadline, owner.reserve and owner.check(); deadline/reserve must not change.
Prepared unique output directory and actual services/ownership.json engine argv receipt.
report.source with identity, SDK clock_domain, cost_spec and absolute nominal_protocol.json entry in source_pins; report.configuration.engine matches owned actual argv.
Exact caller source and accepted adapter must receive external Mayor approval before --execute; source/qualification proposal is not that approval.
Same approved immutable warmup3 and Train five-request engineering inputs at results/mpc-native-r24/reviews/resume-p0-probes02/inputs/{warmup,admission-boundary}.json.

traffic_and_timing.before_traffic: Re-read startup-pinned protocol; require exact accepted adapter935c2679; record caller, adapter and protocol hashes in qualification-source-binding.json.
traffic_and_timing.warmup: Use unchanged prepare_capture/capture_replay, original D/R and recorder's own clock label; persist raw capture even on failure/interruption.
traffic_and_timing.before_S: Inspect prepared.error before recorder/trace; prove metrics drain and zero tokenizer fallback, then obtain actual source identity/clock/cost state.
traffic_and_timing.permit: Unchanged entered+20.0 expiry and max_commands=8, under separate Mayor authority; S+max(episode_s,trace_window) must fit both permit expiry and original D-R.
traffic_and_timing.episode: Accepted run_episode, RuntimeLimits and runtime/permit/entry/solve/age/version/budget guards remain unchanged.
traffic_and_timing.final: Attempt raw-recorded metrics drain on success/failure within original D-R and owner.check; close the caller client; recheck source hashes; persist caller receipts.

accounting.episode_trace_requests: Validated trace count only after successful preparation; otherwise null
accounting.offered_requests_from_driver: Allocated in-place capture record count; no longer the planned trace count
accounting.episode_sent_requests: Count of non-null sent_at when every record exposes it; otherwise null
accounting.unknown: Absent capture after entering run is unknown/null, not invented zero; actual unknown/not_launched fates remain unchanged in raw capture
accounting.clock_labels: Preserve different real SDK_source, warmup_recorder and episode_recorder labels; do not substitute the SDK string into recorder.capture_replay

outputs.qualification-source-binding.json: Caller/accepted adapter/protocol SHA pins written before traffic
outputs.runtime-binding.json: Actual runtime protocol description plus exact caller/adapter SHA, original offered_start and unchanged permit bounds
outputs.pre-episode-metrics-NNNN.json_and_final-: Every attempt with raw response/status, parsed value or error, timestamps and positive timeout; semantic drain/fallback failures also remain in caller_errors
outputs.pre-control-state-observation.json: Raw bounded source-state GET receipt, including failures
outputs.warmup-capture.json: Unchanged accepted recorder codec; .write-error.json on encoding/write failure if storage permits
outputs.warmup-not-run.json: Explicit absence when no warmup capture was constructed
outputs.episode-not-run-capture.json: Distinct caller raw capture before run, or explicitly labeled absent-capture-v1 receipt rather than counterfeit raw-v2
outputs.caller-episode-capture.json: Distinct caller persistence of in-place capture after run; does not overwrite adapter evidence
outputs.episode-not-run.json: Caller-owned NOT_RUN receipt with original reason and actual allocation/sent counts
outputs.episode-invalid-result.json: Strict-safe error and repr for unscorable adapter return; never insert invalid return into terminal report
outputs.qualification-caller.json: Strict-safe terminal accounting/primary/secondary errors; missing file from a write failure is itself fatal, not successful collection

binding_boundary: Caller SHA is external runtime-binding provenance. Accepted adapter immutable preparation inputs, scenario binding, runtime protocol schema and permit internal source-digest ABI were not modified.
full_wall: Always null here; only Mayor lifecycle cleanup can finalize actual startup-to-final-drain full wall.
